info.description:
ReArch API: deterministic legacy-code analysis, a modernization recommendation and a roadmap.
Every figure is computed by Python from facts; assumptions are ILLUSTRATIVE and the client scenario is fictional.
Any number can be explained with `GET /explain/{number_id}`.
info.title: ReArch API

put.description:
Merge the edit into the current scenario. If anything changed, a new version is created and the results are recomputed
synchronously (no re-analysis, tens of milliseconds); the slow sensitivity search then runs in the background.

get.description: Flip points and breakevens per package (the run's selected profile). Computed on first request if the background job has not.

post.description: Compute a partial scenario without persisting anything, and diff it against the current scenario.

schema.title: Response Get Explain Explain  Number Id  Get
